line: Lenovo ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 14 Aura Edition (2026, Panther Lake)
config_name: ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 14 — Core Ultra 9 386H vPro, 64GB LPDDR5, 2TB SSD, 14" 2.8K 120Hz matte OLED

specs.keyboard_notes: ThinkPad keyboard 1.5mm travel, TrackPoint, haptic touchpad

battery.notes: 58Wh. CNET: ~9-10h light mixed use on reviewed OLED config; Ultra 9 tier slightly lower under load.

price.notes: Top CTO tier (Ultra 9 + 64GB + 2TB) est. from CNET US$2,374 mid-tier anchor + ~US$1,000 spec uplift x ~1.3. Lenovo CA eCoupon pricing applies.

reviews.quote: The X1 Carbon Gen 14 introduces Lenovo's Space Frame chassis that features a smaller motherboard and larger cooling fans, along with a modular design that makes it easier to access and then repair or replace individual components.
the X1 Carbon is lighter than MacBooks, starting at 1 kilo for the OLED variant

praises: 64GB in a 1 kg ThinkPad — the only way to get serious local-AI/RAM headroom at this weight
vPro on the Ultra 9 tier for enterprise fleet management
2TB replaceable Gen4 SSD in a chassis where the SSD is actually user-swappable
Same matte 2.8K 120Hz OLED as the cheaper tiers — no panel tax at the top
Space Frame repairability holds across every tier including this one
complaints: Ultra 9 H chip is thermally capped in a 1 kg fan-cooled chassis — little real uplift over Ultra 7
Battery is the shortest of any X1 Carbon generation per CNET's comparison
$4,500+ CAD territory before eCoupons — MacBook Pro money
iGPU only: the Arc B390 GPU option belongs to the Core Ultra X7 tier, not this one
RAM still soldered despite 64GB — expensive to buy right the first time

design_philosophy: The maximum-spec X1 Carbon for executives and road warriors whose workloads (VMs, large datasets, local models) demand headroom in a 1 kg machine. Performance-per-dollar is poor versus the Ultra 7 tiers; this entry exists because fleet catalogs and configurators sell it.
rating_notes: Inferred from CNET/Ultrabookreview Gen 14 OLED reviews (same chassis/panel): Ultra 9 386H vs reviewed Ultra 7 → productivity +0.5 but thermals_noise −1 (H-series capped in 1 kg chassis), battery −0.5. 64GB → ai_ml +1 and productivity headroom vs 32GB siblings. Price estimated.
